g.text: Inspired O₂ partial pressure = (total pressure − 47 mmHg water vapour) × O₂ fraction; limits from NASA-STD-3001 Vol. 2 (Rev F, 2026). Lower total pressure means less
nitrogen and shorter pre-EVA oxygen prebreathe.
